description: For a mail domain: lists up to 3 MX hosts with their IPv4 addresses and, from Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data, which SMTP ports (25, 465, 587) were seen open on each address. Passive and possibly old; no SMTP conversation, banner, STARTTLS or certificate test is made. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_crossdomain_xml_test when you need to read a site's public crossdomain.xml; security_smb_exposure_test when you need to check Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 445. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_mx_server_test
